methodology_note: Source-derived PYQ counts extracted from the user-supplied Mathematics PDF, with E-M-T-O preserved for 2019–2025. Active topic rows exclude any subtopic with O=0 in both 2024 and 2025, exactly as requested. Chapter-level yearly totals and every source trend/suggestion text are preserved. Excluded-topic labels are listed separately without their historical count rows.
denominator_limit: The PDFs provide annual aggregate counts, not the number of shifts or a complete shift-by-shift question inventory. These values are not probabilities or expected counts for one future shift.
syllabus_limit: Historical/source-authored syllabus comments and study advice are preserved verbatim after whitespace normalization; they are attributed to the source document and are not presented as an independent syllabus verification.
exclusion_rule: A topic is excluded from the active topic matrix only if its source O/Overall count is exactly 0 in both 2024 and 2025. It is listed under excluded_topics by name and PDF page, with no counts. Chapter-level totals remain the source-reported totals; for years before 2024, the chapter total can include excluded topics and therefore may not equal the sum of active topic rows.

chapters.title: Basic of Mathematics
chapters.recent_trend: We use Inequalities in multiple other chapters, and this is the core of JEE mathematics. Learn how to use Descartes' rule to feel comfortable in solving inequalities in any other chapter. Basic properties of Logarithms will be useful in questions of Calculus & Algebra. Learn how to draw graphs for standard curves.
chapters.expert_suggestion: Just cover how to use Descartes’s rule in Inequalities, as it will be used in multiple other chapters, and cover the use of standard properties of logarithms.

chapters.title: Quadratic Equation
chapters.recent_trend: ‘Relation between Roots and Coefficients’ is an important topic, with many tough questions asked on it. The high number of questions on the Higher Power of Roots / Newton's formula in the last three years. Several tricky N-degree equation questions, especially those reducible to quadratic equations through substitution. Only 1 Question from common roots was asked in 2025. No need to spend a lot of time on the Location of Roots and Common Roots. The range of a Quadratic is an important concept for mixed questions in other chapters. Direct questions are not expected.
chapters.expert_suggestion: This Chapter is the backbone of mathematics, especially the Algebra component. Make sure to understand the basics – when a quadratic is always positive or negative, how to find the range of a quadratic, and how to solve quadratic inequalities – as it will be used in other chapters as well. N- degree equations and reducible to quadratic by substitution are very important

chapters.title: Complex Number

topics.name: Euler Form and De Moivres Theorem

chapters.recent_trend: The Triangle Inequality was removed from the 2024 syllabus, but we still saw a few questions in 2024 & 2025 on maximum and minimum value. Overall weightage of Complex Numbers is constant in the last three years, and we saw a few straightforward questions as well. Moderate-level questions on Conjugate, Modulus and Argument in the last three years. Challenging Questions from Geometry of Complex Numbers were asked in the last 3 years. Understanding basic properties of straight lines and circles helps in geometry problems. Questions involving conceptual applications of Polar Form, Euler Form and De Moivre’s Theorem were asked. Cube Roots of Unity play a significant role across multiple chapters.
chapters.expert_suggestion: This chapter is tricky, and recently the level has also increased. Students generally face difficulty and try to leave this chapter. Even if you are planning to leave this chapter, prepare the Topic – Cube Root of Unity. You might find questions on this topic in the questions of other chapters.
chapters.source_notes: Qs in this chapter marked with ^ denotes out of syllabus but good to solve qs

chapters.title: Sequences and Series

topics.name: Mixed Question on AP and GP

chapters.recent_trend: Summation of Series was removed from the main syllabus, but multiple questions are still asked in 2024 & 2025. Do not leave the Summation of Series even if it is not mentioned in the syllabus. The weightage of Sequences and Series remained constant in 2024 and 2025. No questions on Mixed AP and GP were asked in 2025. Lengthy questions were asked on the summation of series before 2024. Tough questions involving Recursive Relations were asked in the last 3 years. The AM-GM Inequality is highly useful in other chapters, though no direct question was asked in 2025. A new type of question involving exponential and logarithmic series was asked before 2024.
chapters.expert_suggestion: This chapter is one of the favourites at JEE Mains – a MUST DO. Ideally, one should do it well. But you should make sure that the topics such as Sum of Series, Questions by Vn Method, and basic use of AM- GM inequality should be mastered, as they are used in questions of other chapters. Do the basics of the Summation Series, even if it is not mentioned in the 2024 syllabus; we saw multiple questions in 2024 and 2025.
chapters.source_notes: Qs in this chapter marked with * denotes out of syllabus qs and ^ denotes out of syllabus but good to solve qs

chapters.title: Permutation Combination

topics.name: Selection of one or more item
Division and Distribution of Distinct Items

chapters.recent_trend: 2025 was on the easier side as compared to 2023 & 2024 papers. Tricky questions on the modification of dictionary problems have been asked in recent years. Questions mixed with Matrices, Determinants, and Vectors have been asked. The majority of moderate questions have been asked about the arrangement under constraints and the selection of items. Standard questions on a number of Integral Solutions mixed with other chapters. Scoring questions on Geometric Permutation were asked in 2025. Tricky questions on the summation of numbers and divisors were asked in the last three years.
chapters.expert_suggestion: This is one of those chapters that students are not able to grasp well. It definitely requires time and enough practice to master the concepts from this chapter. But this chapter is important for Probability as well. So, you should at least prepare the different methods of basic arrangement. If possible, also do the topic – Number of Integral Solutions – as questions based on this are asked in Matrices, Determinants and Vectors

chapters.title: Binomial Theorem

topics.name: Integral and Fractional Part of a Number

chapters.recent_trend: The sum of the Series was removed from the main syllabus, but still, we had questions in 2024 & 2025. So do not leave this topic. Overall weightage nearly doubled in 2023 paper but returned to 2022 standard in 2024 & 2025. Moderate to Tough Level questions from the Terms of Binomial Expansion. A smaller number of direct questions have been asked in the last 3 years. Recently high number of questions have been asked from Remainder and Divisibility Problems, with a few tricky questions in recent years. Students should practice Remainder problems, Finding the last 1-2-3 Digit problems. 1 question of the Multinomial Theorem was asked in 2025. We used to get tricky questions on Series involving Product of Coefficients before 2024.
chapters.expert_suggestion: Overall Binomial Theorem is one of the difficult chapters in JEE Mains. Students need to practice more questions to get a better hold of this chapter. Even if you are planning to leave this chapter, do practice basic questions on binomial expansion and the properties of binomial expansion. They might be used in a series of problems in other chapters, such as Definite Integration. Remainder-based questions have a fixed pattern for solving questions.
chapters.source_notes: Qs in this chapter marked with * denotes out of syllabus qs

chapters.title: Mathematical Reasoning
chapters.recent_trend: This chapter is completely removed from the 2024 & 2025 syllabus. Most trickiest questions involve implication or double implication before 2024. Standard questions of tautology, contradiction, implication, and double implication have been asked every year. A high number of questions are based on the Truth Table of different complicated statements in 2022 and 2023. Questions became trickier in 2022 and 2023. Standard questions were asked in 2020 and 2021. Scoring questions of negation, contrapositive, converse, and inverse of a statement have been asked.
chapters.expert_suggestion: This chapter is removed from JEE Mains, and most students never study this chapter. Solve PYQs only if you are preparing for other state exams and BITSAT.
chapters.source_notes: Qs in this chapter marked with * denotes out of syllabus qs

chapters.title: Statistics

topics.name: Relation Between Variance and Mean Deviation

chapters.recent_trend: Statistics had higher weightage in 2023, but it’s been steadily dropping in both 2024 and 2025. Questions of statistics generally involve lengthy calculations using standard concepts. Scoring but calculation-intensive questions have been asked from Measures of Dispersion - Mean & Variance. The majority of questions are based on mean and variance. If you know formulae and practice PYQs, then you can easily score high. Questions on Median have been asked in last three years.
chapters.expert_suggestion: A MUST DO chapter. But do not take it lightly. Questions are calculative and sometimes tricky as well. If you know the formulae and practice various patterns, you should be able to score in this chapter. In short, Practice PYQs twice and in-depth to understand the kind of questions you will get on the final day

chapters.title: Matrices
chapters.recent_trend: Weightage of Matrices is the same in the 2024 and 2025 papers. Some very challenging questions were asked in the 2022 & 2023 papers. 2025 PYQs are Moderate in comparison. A high number of questions on the Product of Matrices. A few lengthy questions were also asked in the last 3 years. A Lot of questions on Adjoint and its Properties and Inverse of a matrix in recent years. It is a must-do. This topic has literally increased both in weightage and in difficulty as compared to pre-2021. Tricky questions involving Permutations and Combinations were asked in the last 4 years.
chapters.expert_suggestion: A MUST DO chapter. But its difficulty has increased in recent years. Make sure to solve recent PYQs to get an idea about what is expected and check whether you have practised those kinds of questions on your end or not. Also, you might find some questions using concepts from Permutations. Check the pattern.

chapters.title: Determinants
chapters.recent_trend: System of Linear Equations is Scoring and Must Do, we get one question in almost every paper in 2024 and 2025. Weightage is the same in 2023 and 2024, which is very unexpected. Significant drop in 2025. Questions on the expansion of determinants can have lengthy calculations. Multiple questions are mixed with trigonometric equations & different algebra chapters. Revise the basics of trigonometric equations as well.
chapters.expert_suggestion: A MUST DO chapter. Has remained mostly the same over the last few years. But good questions involving trigonometric equations have been asked recently. So, you might be good at Determinants, but still would not get those 4 marks because of weak basics in Trigonometry. Check out such questions in the PYQs. Understand the pattern and solve these questions in depth. Do not skip the system of linear equations.

chapters.title: Probability

topics.name: Random Variable and its Probability Distribution

chapters.recent_trend: The weightage of Probability has been constantly decreasing over the last 4 years. Bernoulli trials and Binomial Distribution have been removed from JEE Mains syllabus. The majority of questions involve concepts of Permutation and Combination. A high number of questions on the Classical Definition of Probability have been asked in recent years. Multiple questions are tricky and lengthy. The majority of questions on Conditional Probability and Multiplication Theorem involve PnC and Set theory. The weightage of Bayes' Theorem is significant in the last 3 years.
chapters.expert_suggestion: A tricky chapter for a lot of students. It also has a lot of prerequisites to understand it in depth. You have to be good at the basics of Permutations to be good at this chapter. But even if you are planning to leave this chapter, you can still give it a shot at Random Variable questions. They are easy and scoring.
chapters.source_notes: Qs in this chapter marked with * denotes out of syllabus qs

chapters.title: Sets and Relations

topics.name: Questions on number of relations and sets
Questions on Symmetric Transitive and Reflexive Properties

chapters.recent_trend: The weightage of this chapter has drastically increased in the last 3 years. Questions based on adding elements in a set to make it symmetric, transitive, and reflexive are common in 2024 & 2025. Students generally get confused by the different symbols and language of the questions in this chapter. Moderate questions on symmetric, transitive, and reflexive Properties have been asked in the past two years. Scoring questions on a Venn diagram has been asked in recent years. Lengthy and Tricky questions on a number of relations and sets have been asked in the last two years.
chapters.expert_suggestion: A moderate chapter that can feel a bit challenging at the start. Recently, there has been a change in the level and style of questions asked at the Mains Level. Cover PYQs of recent years to understand the pattern.

chapters.title: Functions
chapters.recent_trend: The weightage of Functions was very high in the last 3 years. Scoring questions from the domain and range have been asked in the last 4 years. Weightage is maintained in 2025 as well. The weightage of questions involving functional equations is decreased in 2024. It's back to high weightage in 2025. Tough questions on Types of Function (Mapping) were asked in 2024 and 2025. Questions based on Types of Function (Mapping) are generally mixed with other concepts. High weightage of questions involving composite functions and multiple questions with composite functions involved at one or other step in a question. Multiple Tricky questions on a number of functions were asked in 2022 and 2023 for the first time, and the trend continued in 2025. Doable questions on the definition of function have been asked in 2025.
chapters.expert_suggestion: This chapter is the backbone of the entire Calculus. And in recent years, it has gained both in weightage and in difficulty. Really difficult problems have been asked. But you cannot neglect this chapter. Do not get bogged down by the difficulty. Keep your basics right for this chapter, as the concepts of this chapter will be used in the entire calculus

chapters.title: Limits
chapters.recent_trend: Limits had way more weightage than expected in 2024, but saw a sharp drop in 2025. Students should use L'Hospital's Rule (LH Rule) to simplify tough questions. Questions based on the Sandwich Theorem are increased in 2024, but no significant weightage in 2025. Questions based on Series Expansion are increased in 2024 & some questions were asked in 2025 as well. More difficult-looking questions have been asked about Algebraic and Rational limits. Questions involve standard methods, but they look difficult. Questions on Trigonometry and Inverse Trigonometric limits are almost negligible in 2025, but it is very important to solve mixed chapter problems.
chapters.expert_suggestion: This chapter has changed its pattern in JEE Mains. Questions in 2024 & 2025 (especially) were different from their predecessors. But still, it is a low-input and high-scoring chapter. Check the recent trend and prepare accordingly. Do solve the last 3 years' previous years to check the latest new pattern

chapters.title: Continuity and Differentiability
chapters.recent_trend: The weightage of Continuity and Differentiability has significantly decreased compared to 2024. Recent years have seen many questions focused on the differentiability of the modulus function. Many questions on the continuity of the Greatest Integer function have appeared recently. Tricky problems combining it with composite functions were asked over the last three years. In 2024, continuity and differentiability had balanced weightage, but in 2025, differentiability regained focus. Differentiability questions involving functional equations and graphs have had low weightage in recent years.
chapters.expert_suggestion: This chapter is one of the Most Difficult chapters at JEE Mains. Weightage decreased suddenly in 2025, with a focus on mixed chapter questions. In 2023 & 2024, the trend continued with some questions touching the JEE Advanced level. You either know this chapter or you do not. Doing PYQs in depth and doing them twice or thrice is the practice that you can do for this chapter if you have limited time.

chapters.title: Differentiation
chapters.recent_trend: Only 1 direct question was asked about Differentiation in 2025. The weightage of direct questions from Differentiation has increased drastically in 2024. Differentiation of composite functions was the highlight of 2024. The weightage of higher-order derivatives has increased in the last three years. We generally never get any tough questions from differentiation. Differentiation of Inverse Trigonometric Functions was important till 2021, but no questions have been asked since then. Standard questions have been asked about Parametric and Logarithmic differentiation are useful in other chapters.
chapters.expert_suggestion: Weightage was negligible in 2025, but we saw multiple direct questions in 2024. Differentiation is useful in other chapters of calculus. And also, not very difficult to grasp. Just do it

chapters.title: Application of Derivatives
chapters.recent_trend: Tangent Normals and Mean Value Theorem have been removed from JEE Mains Syllabus. The Mean Value Theorem was removed from the syllabus, but it still appeared in 2024, but it was not asked in 2025. In the past 3 years, several mixed questions involving AOD and other chapters have been asked. Monotonicity questions are usually lengthy and often combined with other concepts. Tough questions on the Monotonicity of functions involving the Modulus function and the Composite function in the last three years. Questions using AOD to find roots of equations have been frequently asked in recent years. Moderate Maxima-Minima questions on algebraic and trigonometric equations had high weightage earlier, but have decreased recently. Very low weightage of Rate Measure in the last 3 years.
chapters.expert_suggestion: The difficulty of this chapter has increased in recent years. Questions are calculative and becoming trickier. Practice PYQ questions to understand the change in the level of questions asked. Tangent Normals and the Mean Value Theorem are removed from the syllabus.
chapters.source_notes: Qs in this chapter marked with * denotes out of syllabus qs

chapters.title: Indefinite Integration
chapters.recent_trend: The weightage of indefinite integration has suddenly increased in the last 3 years, but it's still not compatible with Definite Integration. Integration by substitution involving expressions like f '(x) divided or multiplied by f(x), and trigonometric rational functions, is important. Similar questions like PYQs have been repeated multiple times in the last 3 years. Indefinite Integration by Parts was absent in 2024 but made a return in 2025. Integration by substitution involving rational and irrational functions is highly important. Examiner is your friend. Use repeated terms in the options to solve questions quickly and find clues for substitution.
chapters.expert_suggestion: This chapter is lengthy and requires some time for mastery. The good part is that the questions asked so far are not that tough. If you have prepared well, you will be able to score well. Also, this chapter is important as it is used in Area and Differential Equations extensively. Though in these chapters, limited concepts of Indefinite are used. So, you can plan accordingly.

chapters.title: Definite Integration
chapters.recent_trend: The weightage of Definite Integration is high with multiple JEE Advanced Style questions. Most questions involve Properties of Definite Integration mixed with other concepts. In 2025, definite integration was part of one step of multi-chapter PYQs. Integration of the modulus function or the greatest integer function is the hot topic. Questions are more lengthy and tricky in 2022 & 2023 as compared to 2024 & 2025. Moderate questions on Leibniz Rule of Differentiation in 2024 and 2025. It is easy to master. No need to remember reduction formulae, use by parts. Definite as Limit of Sum has been removed from JEE Mains syllabus, but in 2024, we still got 1 question from this topic.
chapters.expert_suggestion: More questions have been asked in the last 3 years from this chapter. And there has been a drastic change in the style of the questions that are asked. Questions are trickier now. Need thorough practice on this chapter, or else scoring might be difficult. Check the pattern by solving questions that came in the last three years on priority.
chapters.source_notes: Qs in this chapter marked with * denotes out of syllabus qs

chapters.title: Area Under Curves
chapters.recent_trend: The weightage of the Area Under the Curves has been consistent in the last 3 years. In 2025, Area Between Curves often appeared as one step within multi-chapter mixed questions, which is a common trend. Questions involving areas bounded by Miscellaneous Curves have been asked in the last two years. Many questions on areas bounded by Miscellaneous Curves involve an understanding of curve sketching using AOD. Questions involving modulus and the greatest integer function were asked in 2024 & 2025. Many questions have been asked about the Area bounded by two curves. We don't need to draw a graph in most of these questions. Use basic formulae for the area of a triangle, a sector, a quadrilateral, etc, to save time.
chapters.expert_suggestion: This chapter is considered an easy one at the Mains level. Some questions could be solved directly using the area of a sector, a triangle, and a trapezium. One can speedily solve questions if one can understand the symmetry. Otherwise, you might take some time to solve a question, but make sure that you get those 4 marks from this chapter.

chapters.title: Differential Equations
chapters.recent_trend: Formation of Differential Equations has been removed from JEE Mains syllabus. The Linear Differential Equation is the main highlight of the last three years. Questions are generally looked at as tricky, but can be solved by standard concepts. High weightage of differential equations reducible to LDE in the last three years. Questions became very lengthy in 2022, and weightage was increased in 2022, and the pattern is similar in 2024 & 2025. Good questions have been asked about Variable Separable Form and Homogeneous DE in the last two years. Some questions can consume a lot of time due to calculations. Tricky questions on Exact Forms have been asked in 2023 and 2024, especially.
chapters.expert_suggestion: This chapter has limited concepts but 2 topics, especially – Reducible to Linear Differential Equation and Exact Forms – require some practice to master. Also, the JEE Mains has started to ask some tricky questions on the above topics. There has been a shift towards a new style of questions. Make sure to solve 2021-2022 PYQs to understand the pattern first if you struggle with 2024-2025 PYQs.
chapters.source_notes: Qs in this chapter marked with * denotes out of syllabus qs

chapters.title: Straight Lines
chapters.recent_trend: Even after syllabus reduction, Straight Lines had double the weightage in 2024, but in 2025, its weightage dropped noticeably. Very High weightage of Coordinate System - Area of triangle, different centres of triangles are part of many questions. Overall, lengthy questions were asked in the last 3 years. Questions from Basic Forms of Straight Line, Point and Line are scoring and must do. Low number of questions from the Parametric form of line in 2024 & 2025 as compared to earlier years. Angle bisector & Family of lines have been removed from the syllabus in 2024. Rarely have questions been asked from the Family of Lines in recent years.
chapters.expert_suggestion: One of the MUST-Do Chapters for JEE Main. There are a lot of topics in the chapter, but they are not tricky and not tough to master. The style of questions has drastically changed in the 2023 & 2024 papers, 2025 was similar to 2024 style with a bias towards coordinate systems and different centres like centroid, incentre, orthocentre and circumcenter. Focus on learning formulae and their applications, even if it takes some time. Do not leave this chapter at any cost.
chapters.source_notes: Qs in this chapter marked with * denotes out of syllabus qs and ^ denotes out of syllabus but good to solve qs

chapters.title: Circle
chapters.recent_trend: Multi-chapter and multi-concept questions are frequently asked in 2025. Tangent and Normals have been removed from JEE Mains syllabus. Focus is shifted to the Equation of a Circle & its intercept, line and circle in 2024 & 2025. Equation of Circle & its intercept is an important concept for other chapters in the syllabus. We can get mixed questions with other chapters. Few questions from the Chord of a circle and the number of Common Tangents were asked in the last 3 years. Very lengthy locus-based problems were asked in 2023, but less lengthy problems have been asked in 2024 & 2025. Tough & Tricky questions were asked from Tangent to Circles before 2023.
chapters.expert_suggestion: This is a big chapter with a lot of topics that require some practice. And for some students, it might be time-consuming. Sometimes basic geometry also helps to solve questions quickly. After covering the basics of this chapter, try to solve the PYQs to grasp the pattern of questions asked and then plan extra practice. Solve PYQs in depth learning mode.
chapters.source_notes: Qs in this chapter marked with * denotes out of syllabus qs and ^ denotes out of syllabus but good to solve qs

chapters.title: Parabola
chapters.recent_trend: Tangent and Normals have been removed from the syllabus in 2024, but still, 3 questions have been asked in 2025. Students should remember properties instead of solving questions by the basics. High weightage of questions mixed with Ellipse, Hyperbola and Circles were asked. Questions involving the Properties of the Focal Chord are mixed with other concepts, have become useful in recent years. Challenging questions from Tangent to Parabola and Normal to Parabola before 2024 Students are scared of Conic Sections at the start, but it can be improved drastically after one revision. Chord of Contact & Chord with given Middle Point formulae are directly useful in the exam.
chapters.expert_suggestion: For this chapter, first, understand the difference between JEE Mains and JEE Advanced syllabus. If your target at this moment is JEE Mains, then do not try to cover too much, else you will end up wasting a lot of time. There is a repetition of pattern-based questions in this chapter. Solve PYQs to understand those patterns and prepare them in depth. Also, it is better to remember properties from this chapter as they can save a lot of time in the exam
chapters.source_notes: Qs in this chapter marked with * denotes out of syllabus qs and ^ denotes out of syllabus but good to solve qs

chapters.title: Ellipse
chapters.recent_trend: Tangent and Normals were removed from the syllabus in 2024, but surprisingly, a question still appeared in the 2025 paper. Focus is shifted to the Equation of Ellipse in 2024 & 2025. We used to get questions from all topics in earlier years. The chord with the given middle point was a hot topic in 2025. The difficulty of questions has reduced in recent years. High weightage of questions from Tangent to ellipse and Common Tangent in 2022 & 2023 before syllabus reduction.
chapters.expert_suggestion: Tangent and Normals are removed from the syllabus. Now, students don't need to remember miscellaneous properties of Tangent, Normal, and Chord for an Ellipse. There is a huge difference in JEE Mains and JEE Advanced questions on the Ellipse. Solve PYQs to understand the pattern and then practice.
chapters.source_notes: Qs in this chapter marked with * denotes out of syllabus qs and ^ denotes out of syllabus but good to solve qs

chapters.title: Hyperbola

topics.name: Mixed Questions of Ellipse and Hyperbola

chapters.recent_trend: Weightage has increased in 2024 & 2025 even after a reduction in the syllabus. Most questions involve both an ellipse and a hyperbola. Focus on the most important topic Equation of a hyperbola and don't get distracted by JEE Mains. Lengthy questions have been asked about the Equation of a hyperbola. Students should remember the classical definition. We used to get a lot of questions from Tangent and Normal questions before the syllabus reduction. In 2022 and 2023, lengthy questions about Normal to hyperbola were asked. Students are scared of Conic Sections at the start, but it can be improved drastically after one revision.
chapters.expert_suggestion: Do JEE Mains specific Preparation for this chapter. A lot of questions have a combination with other chapters, such as the ellipse and the parabola. Do PYQs to understand the pattern that is most common in this chapter. Tangent and Normals are removed from the syllabus.
chapters.source_notes: Qs in this chapter marked with * denotes out of syllabus qs and ^ denotes out of syllabus but good to solve qs

chapters.title: Trigonometric Ratios & Identities

topics.name: Sum and Difference & Multiple angle Formula
T-Ratios of Multiple & sub multiple angles

chapters.recent_trend: Maximum and Minimum Values of Trigonometric Functions are important for other chapters as well. Students should practice the Multiple Angle Formula and Transformation Formulas, as they will be used in other chapters as well. You will keep on revising trigonometry in almost every other chapter of Maths. It will never leave you. Do not overspend time on this chapter, the goal is to get comfortable with standard formulae and it's application. The application of a range of trigonometric functions is important in other chapters as well.
chapters.expert_suggestion: This is a Low Output High Input Chapter. Do not waste your time in doing too difficult problems. Ideally, you should know the basics and the entire formula list from this chapter. Math is nothing without Trigonometry and its formulas. Also, another very commonly used topic is the Range of Trigonometric Functions – do it properly, as this will help you in other chapters

chapters.title: Trigonometric Equations
chapters.recent_trend: Surprisingly, the weightage of this chapter is more than Trigonometric Ratios, even if it was not mentioned in the JEE Mains Syllabus. Good and sometimes tricky questions have been asked about solving Trigonometric Equations - solving equations by factorisation and transformation formulae. Mixed-type questions with Trigonometric Ratios were asked in the last 2 years, which was unexpected.
chapters.expert_suggestion: Practice the questions of this chapter properly, even if it is not mentioned in the syllabus directly. Nowadays, questions of different chapters will involve trigonometric equations at their last step, and this trend has been common in the last three years
chapters.source_notes: Qs in this chapter marked with ^ denotes out of syllabus but good to solve qs

chapters.title: Inverse Trigonometric Functions

topics.name: Converting one Inverse T function to other Inverse T

chapters.recent_trend: Always check the domain and range in inverse trigonometry questions, as the examiner may try to trick you. Many tough inverse trigonometric equations-based questions involve finding the domain and range of inverse trigonometric functions. Multiple questions involving properties of inverse trigonometric functions in one step of the solution in the past 3 years. The overall weightage of questions on the Sum and difference of angles & interconversion of functions has increased from 2024 to 2025. Only 1 question was asked from Infinite Series involving tan and cot inverse in 2025. The weightage of this concept has decreased since 2021.
chapters.expert_suggestion: Overall, Inverse Trigonometry is a scoring topic, but it requires practice with some challenging problems. Students generally just prepare the basic level, and then they make silly errors. Good questions on the domain and when the inverse properties can be applied based on their principal value have been asked in recent years.

chapters.title: Vector Algebra
chapters.recent_trend: The overall weightage of Vector Algebra has decreased in 2024 and 2025 following the syllabus reduction. The difficulty level of Vector Algebra questions was notably higher in 2024 compared to 2025. Over the past three years, many scoring questions were based on the product of two vectors. Tricky questions involving various centres of triangles were there - understanding of straight lines will help us. Recent papers have included questions testing the geometric applications of dot and cross product. Direct questions on collinearity and vector projection have also been asked. Scalar Triple Product and Vector Triple Product have been removed from the JEE Mains Syllabus.
chapters.expert_suggestion: An important chapter in JEE Mains. Scoring as well. But generally, students don’t find it that way. Break that notion from your mind. This is a very pattern-oriented chapter where every topic has different patterns of questions that can be asked. If you can do them all and in-depth, your 4 marks are definite from this chapter. Solve PYQs in learning mode to understand the pattern and realise it yourself.

chapters.title: Three Dimensional Geometry
chapters.recent_trend: Three Dimensional Geometry continues to be an important chapter for JEE Mains, even after the syllabus reduction. The weightage of this chapter was drastically increased in 2023 and is back to the average 2-3 questions per shift in 2024 & 2025. Planes have been removed from the JEE Mains syllabus, which earlier included some tricky PYQs. Line in Space is the main focus of this chapter and can be mastered using only the 2024 and 2025 PYQs. Scoring questions on the shortest distance between lines & point and a line appeared in 2024 and 2025. Multiple Line in Space questions involve lengthy calculations using direct methods. Don't waste time on Plane in Space. It’s removed from the JEE Mains syllabus.
chapters.expert_suggestion: Three-Dimensional Geometry is one of the most important chapters for JEE Mains. You can easily check that from the weightage every year. It is a lengthy chapter, but the majority of questions come from the topic Line in Space after the syllabus change. You need to practice all the variations and different kinds of questions that can be formed from a single topic. There are many PYQs to learn from. Also, NCERT is a very good resource for practising relevant questions for this chapter. Whatever you do, make sure to master this chapter if you want to score high in Math at JEE Mains
